title: Electrodeposited CoSe2 supported on BiVO4 as an efficient photoanode for the enhanced photoelectrochemical water oxidation
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2149-2158
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01469C, Paper
M. Nikandish, D. Taherinia, S. Ghasemian
This work reports a novel multilayer photoanode (CoSe2/BiVO4/FTO) for the efficient photoelectrochemical oxidation of water.
